behaviors.behavior: Gate judges the DELTA, not the whole row: a legacy-dirty Name is not re-flagged by a description-only edit
behaviors.evidence: `test_ignores_a_legacy_dirty_name_when_only_description_is_edited` PASSED — internal Opus plan-review finding (HIGH), fixed and pinned

behaviors.behavior: Gate judges the DELTA: a fold that adds one clean criterion does not inherit a block from a different, pre-existing malformed criterion on the same row
behaviors.evidence: `test_ignores_legacy_dirty_criteria_when_a_clean_criterion_is_folded_in` PASSED — same finding, criteria half

behaviors.behavior: A row reinstated from `## Removed Requirements` (criteria section present at base all along) does not inherit a block on its unchanged legacy criteria
behaviors.evidence: `test_reinstated_row_does_not_inherit_a_legacy_malformed_criterion` PASSED — Stage-2 code-reviewer finding (MEDIUM), fixed and pinned; genuinely reddens under the pre-fix code (traced by the reviewer)

behaviors.behavior: An already-merged commit (base_sha == commit) reports an honest skip, not a false "clean"
behaviors.evidence: `test_reports_skip_when_commit_is_already_contained_in_the_trunk` PASSED — Stage-2 code-reviewer finding (MEDIUM), fixed and pinned

behaviors.behavior: A brand-new spec.md (absent at merge-base) is judged against an empty base, not treated as an infra failure
behaviors.evidence: `test_passes_when_a_brand_new_spec_file_is_added` PASSED — glm external-review finding

behaviors.behavior: A violating row in a brand-new spec FILE (not just a new row in an existing file) is still caught — refutes an "untracked file bypass" hypothesis
behaviors.evidence: `test_fails_on_a_dirty_row_in_a_brand_new_spec_file` PASSED — openai external-review claim (HIGH), empirically disproven and pinned

behaviors.behavior: `spec_text_at` returns `""` (not `None`) for a path absent at a valid, resolvable base commit
behaviors.evidence: empirical probe against a real two-commit repo (not a pytest case — recorded in the ADR's External-Code-Review-Findings table) confirms `""`, refuting the openai `None`-false-block claim

behaviors.behavior: `git blame` porcelain `committer-time` for an uncommitted line is current wall-clock time, not `0`
behaviors.evidence: empirical probe against a real repo with an uncommitted edit (recorded in the ADR) confirms non-zero, refuting the glm stale-uncommitted-TBD claim

behaviors.behavior: `FrTableRow.text` is the Description-preferred cell only, never the whole physical row
behaviors.evidence: code inspection of `_fr_table_columns.title_cell` (recorded in the ADR) confirms, refuting the glm Priority/Basis-edit-triggers-block claim

behaviors.behavior: A dirty row added TWO commits back on the branch, with an unrelated commit as HEAD, is still caught (the merge-base range is used, not a single-commit fallback)
behaviors.evidence: `test_a_dirty_row_added_in_an_earlier_commit_is_still_caught_at_a_later_head` PASSED — doubt-review finding (HIGH), fixed and pinned

behaviors.behavior: A non-canonical FR id (e.g. `FR-1.02`) this run adds, carrying a dirty name/description, is still flagged instead of silently invisible
behaviors.evidence: `test_a_non_canonical_id_this_run_added_is_still_flagged` PASSED — doubt-review finding (MEDIUM), fixed and pinned

behaviors.behavior: A criterion anchored OUTSIDE the recognised `## Acceptance Criteria` region (same id already found inside it) still marks the row touched
behaviors.evidence: `test_a_criterion_anchored_outside_the_recognised_ac_region_is_still_touched` PASSED — doubt-review finding (MEDIUM), fixed and pinned

behaviors.behavior: A wholly-TBD `/shipwright-adopt` spec (no feature has any AC) still renders each FR's `TBD_MARKER` under its own `### FR-xx.yy` heading, not undifferentiated prose
behaviors.evidence: `test_an_all_tbd_adoption_still_renders_the_marker_under_an_fr_heading` (integration-tests) PASSED — doubt-review finding (MEDIUM), fixed and pinned; renders through the real `_render_spec_md`, not a hand-typed fixture

behaviors.behavior: Merge-base fail-closed check fires unconditionally, before any "was spec.md touched" question — no path is supplied at all
behaviors.evidence: `test_fails_closed_when_merge_base_is_unresolvable` (rewritten) PASSED — doubt-review finding (HIGH), structural fix removed the vulnerable fallback path entirely

behaviors.behavior: Group I's empty-corpus SKIP-on-all-checks set includes I7 and I8, not just I1-I6
